name: Power Simulator X [RELEASE]
desc:
Rise to become the STRONGEST Superhero (or Villain) by building your power and unlocking new abilities⚡

⭐ Join our community + like the game to unlock AUTO TRAIN + 100 TOKENS for FREE! ⭐

Use Code "80KLIKES" for an in-game reward! 💰
Next Code at 90,000 Likes! 👍

💪 Strength: Boost this to deal stronger physical attacks (like fireballs) to other players
🛡️ Durability: Increase this to reduce damage taken and stay alive longer
🧠 Psychic Power: Grow this to unlock mind-based abilities and spot weaker invisible players
⚡ Energy: Upgrade this to improve your stamina for longer dashes and flight 🚀

🖥️ Controls
Q - DASH
LEFT CLICK - TRAIN/ATTACK
R - SWAP TRAINING/COMBAT MODE
CTRL -SHIFTLOCK
